title: tolvi packs list --json output
description: The role packs this binary carries. Packs are owned by tolvi-solo and vendored into the CLI, so this lists what the binary can provision with `tolvi init --pack <name>` rather than what happens to be on disk.

tolvi_version.description: The CLI that produced this output, as `tolvi version` reports it. 'dev' for an unreleased build.

packs.description: Vendored packs, sorted by name. Empty is never expected but encodes as [] rather than null.

name.description: Pack name, as passed to `tolvi init --pack`.

status.description: Only 'available' packs are vendored; 'planned' is carried for parity with the pack's own manifest.

summary.description: One or two sentences on who the pack is for.

verticals.description: The kinds of decision the pack covers.

templates.description: Every template the pack writes into vault/templates/.

file.description: File name as written into vault/templates/.

use.description: What to reach for this template for.
